title: Acquisitions approved by members
subject: This guide addresses the takeovers exception for acquisitions approved by members under item 7 of s611 of the Corporations Act. It covers the disclosure required, voting restrictions, and how ASIC monitors compliance with these requirements.
background: The guide is issued under the Corporations Act 2001 (Cth) for entities subject to Ch 6, including companies with more than 50 members, listed companies, and listed managed investment schemes. It explains ASIC's regulatory approach to the item 7 exception and its policy on exercising discretionary powers in relation to such acquisitions.
ruling: ASIC states that item 7 acquisitions must comply with strict disclosure and voting requirements to ensure shareholder protection. The guide outlines that disclosure documents must contain all information material to the decision, and voting restrictions apply to certain parties. ASIC will monitor compliance and may use its discretionary powers to grant relief where appropriate, but expects full adherence to the legislative framework. The guide also provides practical guidance on the process for submitting meeting documents and applications for relief.
